sources.firstPageSnippet: biochemistry Definition metabolism  Pentose Phosphate Pathway (PPP) or Hexose monophosphate pathway (HMP) is an alternative oxidative pathway for glucose rather glycolysis.  No ATP production (Unlike glycolysis).  Major pathway for NADPH production. Key features  Produces ribose-5-phosphate (Needed for nucleotide synthesis: DNA, RNA, and others)  Each glucose molecule produces 2 NADPH.  First enzyme: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD).  Occurs in the cytosol of many body cells, including RBCs. Increase liver glycolysis & glycogenesis. Liver increases fatty acid synthesis when its glycogen stores are full. Adipose takes up blood glucose by GLUT4

Determine Renal clearance of a drug :  If eliminated only by glomerular filtration Clinical significance of renal clearance Clearance cannot exceed the GFR (127 ml/min).  If clearance is > 127 ml/min: Drug is eliminated also by tubular secretion (e.g. renal clearance of benzyl penicillin = 480 ml/min). 2. Calculate t1/2:  Dosage rate = clearance x cpss DR . El-Sawy 1

sources.firstPageSnippet: PATHOLOGY Approach to Bone Diseases Pyogenic Osteomyelitis Etiology: Predisposing factors Precipitating factors  age 5-15.  pyogenic organisms e.g. Staph auerus infection (80%). 1-Blood borne (hematogenous). 2-Direct (endogenous & exogenous). Osteomyelitis  is normally resistant to bacterial colonization, events such as Although bone trauma, surgery, the presence of foreign bodies, or the placement of prostheses may disrupt bony integrity and lead to the onset of bone infection. Osteomyelitis DR . AHMED HASSAN  can also result from hematogenous spread after bacteremia 1

sources.firstPageSnippet: PATHOLOGY Approach to Joints’ Disease Diseases Osteoarthritis Vs Rheumatoid arthritis Osteoarthritis (OA, degenerative joint disease)  Most common disease of joints.  Degenerative process of articular cartilage in which matrix breakdown exceeds synthesis.  Inflammation is minimal and secondary.  Chronic autoimmune inflammatory disease that affects mainly small joints, & can be systemic. Rheumatoid arthritis  Caused by a cellular and humoral immune response against (RA) self antigens, particularly citrullinated proteins.  TNF plays a central role (TNF antagonists are of clinical benefit).
